title: Research Proposal: Measuring Altruism, Alignment, and Social Welfare in Large Language Model Agents
description: This research proposal studies whether large language models that appear more aligned, safety-conscious, and prosocial in harmful-request benchmarks also behave more cooperatively in strategic games and more sustainably in multi-agent societies. It formalizes the research questions, operational definition of altruism, execution protocol, evaluation plan, infrastructure requirements, and roadmap for extending the current LLM Altruism codebase into reputation-based and open-world social simulations.
